name: Circle of Inner Binding
summary: Beneath the Arathi Highlands, the Circle of Inner Binding holds Myzrael beneath ancient stones. The Stone of Inner Binding anchors the strongest ward, but cracks let the imprisoned princess reach out to wanderers.

sections.title: The Core Seal
sections.body:
South of the main road, towering slabs ring the Stone of Inner Binding on a plateau. The stone thrums with the strongest ward beneath Arathi and its dense geo-magical power. Rumbling Exiles patrol the stones, drawn by the site's resonance or bound there as guardians.

Cracks in the inner seal let the imprisoned Myzrael reach out telepathically. She whispers pleas for freedom to unsuspecting wanderers who handle shards of her stone.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Circle of Inner Binding?
aliases: what does the inner binding do
faq.answer: The Circle holds the Stone of Inner Binding, the strongest ward anchoring Myzrael's prison beneath the earth. It works with other elemental circles scattered through the Arathi Highlands to restrain her below the surface.
Powerful earth elementals guard the circle, chiefly Rumbling Exiles. These rocky behemoths attack anyone who approaches the ritual stones.

faq.q: Who is whispering through the stone?
faq.answer: Myzrael is an ancient and powerful elemental princess imprisoned deep beneath the earth. Her psychic reach has pierced the fractured seal, letting her contact mortal minds through the binding shard.

faq.q: Where is the Circle of Inner Binding located?
aliases: where is circle of inner binding
faq.answer: The Circle stands on an elevated ridgeline in the southern Arathi Highlands, just east of Stromgarde Keep.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can feel raw earthen energy surging through the Circle of Inner Binding. Its ancient, heavy elemental bonds are clear, while the earth spirits' unnatural agitation warns of corruption beneath the soil.
As a mage, you can read an intricate pattern in the stones. Their geometric arrangement forms a lasting containment field that channels and anchors immense subterranean magical pressures.
